name: Aya Healthcare - Nexus EOR (W2)
source: docs/BrassHR_Aya_Nexus_EOR_Workflow(1) 1 (1).docx (v7.0, sections 3.2 and 3.3) + Nexus Step1/Step2/Step3 packets

templates.name: Nexus - Authorization & Release (Background, Drug, References)
templates.description: Candidate authorizes the background check, drug screen, reference checks and credential verification. Includes the Virginia State Police fingerprint / Rap Back acknowledgment for Virginia placements.

templates.name: Nexus - RN Job Description Acknowledgment
templates.description: Role job description with the essential-functions certification and accommodation request. Duplicate per role (LPN, CNA, ...) and pick the matching one in the builder.

templates.name: Nexus - W2 Employment Agreement
templates.description: Nexus W2 offer and employment agreement: duties, required credentials, no-guaranteed-shifts clause, compensation, termination, confidentiality. Signing this is the Pre-Hire to Post-Hire phase gate.

templates.name: Nexus - Orientation Acknowledgment
templates.description: Orientation handbook attestation: HIPAA, OSHA, Elder Justice Act, CDC infection control, GPS time-tracking app and payroll app.

templates.name: Nexus - Hepatitis B Vaccine Declination
templates.description: CDC Hepatitis B vaccine information statement and the OSHA declination for workers who decline or have not provided proof of vaccination.

templates.name: Nexus - Employee Handbook Acknowledgment
templates.description: Employee handbook receipt and acknowledgment, including at-will status and the registry model (no guaranteed shifts; staff self-select shifts).

steps.label: Application (Resume & Profile)
steps.description: Apply-page resume and contact details. Locked as the first applicant step.

steps.label: Screening Complete
steps.description: Recruiter screening is done. Log each phone attempt on the Activity tab, not as a task.

steps.label: Nexus Interview
steps.description: Nexus interview. Log each interview round on the Activity tab.

steps.label: Authorization & Release eSign + Background Check
steps.description: Candidate e-signs the authorization and release (background, drug screen, references, credential verification; Virginia fingerprint / Rap Back acknowledgment when placed in Virginia). Recruiter then runs the background check.

steps.label: Professional References
steps.description: Candidate lists professional references (name, title, facility, phone, email) for the reference checks.

steps.label: Reference Checks
steps.description: Recruiter completes the reference checks authorized in the release.

steps.label: License (Placement State), TB & CPR
steps.description: License in good standing in the placement state, negative TB and current CPR, each with an expiry date. A pending TB file does not block submission to Aya.

steps.label: SSN & Driver's License
steps.description: SSN and driver's license with expiry for the compliance packet.

steps.label: Drug Screen
steps.description: Drug screen result for the compliance packet.

steps.label: OIG Exclusion Check
steps.description: OIG / exclusion list check. The employment agreement requires the worker is not on any exclusion list.

steps.label: Submit to Aya
steps.description: Send the compliance packet to Aya, then move the candidate to Submitted to Aya and wait.

steps.label: Presented to Facility
steps.description: Aya has presented the candidate to the facility.

steps.label: Client Selected
steps.description: Aya / facility said yes. Completing this unlocks Offer & Agreement. If Aya rejects, close the application instead (no worker, no Post-Hire).

steps.label: Pay Rate, Start Date & Status
steps.description: Confirm pay rate, start date and employment status (W2 part-time / PRN registry) with the candidate. These feed the agreement's compensation section.

steps.label: Offer Accepted
steps.description: Candidate accepts the Nexus offer.

steps.label: Job Description Acknowledgment
steps.description: Candidate certifies they can perform the essential functions of the role (with or without accommodation) and lists any accommodation requests.

steps.label: Nexus W2 Employment Agreement eSign (Phase Gate)
steps.description: Candidate e-signs the Nexus W2 employment agreement. Once signed, the candidate becomes a Nexus worker and Post-Hire opens.

steps.label: I-9 Section 1
steps.description: Employee completes I-9 Section 1 on the current USCIS form (no later than the first day of work).

settings.triggerAfter: Nexus W2 Employment Agreement eSign (Phase Gate)

steps.label: Nexus HR / Manager Approval
steps.description: Only when Nexus HR or a manager must approve the hire.

steps.label: Agreement Signed - Convert to Nexus Worker
steps.description: Phase gate: creates or links the Nexus worker, switches to Post-Hire and sets the status to Onboarding.

steps.label: W-4 & State Tax
steps.description: Federal W-4 and state withholding forms.

steps.label: Direct Deposit (Paychex Flex)
steps.description: Worker accepts the Paychex Flex email invite, registers and enters direct deposit details.

steps.label: Payroll Profile (Paychex Flex)
steps.description: Create the worker in Paychex Flex (weekly pay period) and send the registration invite.

steps.label: Benefits Enrollment
steps.description: Benefits selection when the worker is eligible.

steps.label: 401(k) Enrollment
steps.description: Retirement enrollment when the worker is eligible.

steps.label: I-9 Section 2 / E-Verify
steps.description: Employer completes I-9 Section 2 and E-Verify within three business days of the start date.

steps.label: GPS Time-Tracking App Setup
steps.description: Worker is set up in the GPS time-tracking app used to clock in/out and validate timesheets, and has watched the training video.

steps.label: Scheduling System Access (Self-Select Shifts)
steps.description: Registry model: worker gets access to the scheduling system and picks their own shifts. Nexus does not assign mandatory schedules.

steps.label: Facility Badge
steps.description: Facility badge, when the facility issues one.

steps.label: Orientation Acknowledgment
steps.description: Worker reviews the orientation handbook (HIPAA, OSHA, Elder Justice Act, CDC infection control, GPS time tracking, payroll) and e-signs the attestation.

steps.label: Dementia Patient Care Training + Assessment
steps.description: Dementia / Alzheimer's care module (stages, communication, behaviors, wandering, hallucinations) followed by the assessment.

steps.label: Hep B Vaccine Info & Declination
steps.description: Worker reviews the CDC Hepatitis B vaccine information statement and signs the declination. HR can mark it complete instead when proof of vaccination is on file.

steps.label: Employee Handbook & Registry Acknowledgment
steps.description: Worker e-signs receipt of the Nexus employee handbook, including at-will status and the registry model.

steps.label: Facility Safety Training
steps.description: Only when the facility requires its own safety training on top of the Nexus orientation.

steps.label: Certifications & Modules
steps.description: Certifications or training modules required by the facility.

steps.label: Welcome Message
steps.description: Send the welcome message to the new Nexus worker.

steps.label: Welcome Call
steps.description: Welcome call with the new worker.

steps.label: Onboarding Complete
steps.description: Closes the workflow instance and marks the worker Active.
